status_note: filed [#8887](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8887); fixed on main by [#8898](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8898) (bdaf7d1, 2026-11-04), not released. Reproduces on 30.29.0.
summary: `qualify` resolves a name in `WHERE`/`GROUP BY`/`HAVING` that is both an input column and an output alias as the **alias**; DuckDB resolves it as the **column**.
repro: `select a + 1 as a from t group by a having a = 42` with `t(a) = [42]`: DuckDB returns 43, the qualified tree returns nothing.
handling: The lift refuses such names (#252, b387dcd).
